name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum that adds terms for AI features to an existing product agreement, covering input and output ownership, restrictions on use, training on customer data, and disclaimers about accuracy.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: HIPAA business associate agreement between a covered entity and a vendor handling protected health information, covering business associate and company obligations, data rights and restrictions, breach notification and termination.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard terms for selling and buying a cloud or SaaS product, covering the subscription, fees, customer data, confidentiality, warranties, indemnities, liability caps and term and termination.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: GDPR and CCPA data processing agreement between a controller and a processor, covering processing instructions, security measures, sub-processors, data subject requests and international transfers.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Agreement for working with an early customer on a product still in development, covering the design partner's role, feedback, fees and costs, confidentiality and intellectual property in the results.

name: Mutual NDA Cover Page
description: Fill-in cover page for the mutual non-disclosure agreement, naming the parties, the purpose, the term and the governing law, and incorporating the standard terms by reference.

name: Mutual NDA Standard Terms
description: Standard terms of a mutual non-disclosure agreement, covering what counts as confidential information, permitted use and disclosure, the confidentiality period and the return of materials.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Agreement between two companies partnering on defined obligations set out in a cover page, covering fees and taxes, a trademark licence to each other's brand elements, escalation, confidentiality and term and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Short-term agreement letting a prospective customer trial a product before a full commercial contract, covering pilot access and use during the pilot period, evaluation purposes, confidentiality and termination.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard terms for delivering professional services under statements of work, covering the services, ownership of work product, privacy and security, fees and taxes, insurance, indemnification and liability.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Service level terms used alongside a cloud service agreement, covering the uptime commitment, how downtime is measured, excluded events, support response times and service credits.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard terms for licensing software delivered to the customer rather than hosted, covering the licence grant and restrictions, order forms, support, warranties, indemnities and liability.
